summary: SPX +0.72% and NDX +1.43% on an NVIDIA/Salesforce/CrowdStrike earnings melt-up that lifted software (IGV +7.74%) and cyber (CIBR +7.61%) as the only +3% ETFs and XLK as the only green sector, but breadth diverged sharply (151 advancers vs 347 decliners). Smart Money rotated into Hormuz shipping and hard assets, not the day's software winners, into Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote.
